consequence.statement: If the operator does nothing, existing ImageRepository objects remain stored as v1beta2 and the required storage version migration (re-writing all objects and updating status.storedVersions) is left undone before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Run the storage version migration for imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io: re-write all ImageRepository objects and update status.storedVersions before upgrading to the later release that removes v1beta2.

assertion.statement: The storage version of imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until an operator runs a storage version migration (re-writing all objects and updating status.storedVersions) before a later release removes v1beta2.
